notes: Official AWS documentation is primary. Region availability, console flows, prices, quotas, product names and certification objectives change; re-check the exact page immediately before publication. Search results and linked docs were reviewed for core identity, networking, storage, serverless, Well-Architected, AI, costs, Quick and legacy Data Pipeline facts; not every one of the 285 individual topic pages received a separate release-by-release audit.
